verdict.rationale: Debugging a live web app is a fair capability to ask of a coding assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing showing Aider attaching to, inspecting, or debugging a running web application. The closest features are adjacent: `/run` shares one-off command output, `/web` scrapes a page into markdown, and screenshots can be added to the chat. None of these is live-app debugging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
